items.title: Northgate Stamping adds second press line at Kokomo plant
items.snippet: Northgate Stamping is installing a second stamping press line in Kokomo, citing quoting turnaround and ERP integration gaps as the bottleneck on new program intake.

items.title: Northgate Stamping is hiring: ERP Integration Analyst
items.snippet: Northgate Stamping posted an opening for an ERP Integration Analyst to connect plant-floor quoting with the corporate ERP rollout.

items.title: Northgate Stamping cited for scrap-rate reduction in Building C pilot
items.snippet: A regional manufacturing association highlighted Northgate Stamping's Building C pilot, which cut scrap rates using a new quoting-to-floor data dashboard.
